entries.title: What is this mod?
q: whats the point of this mod
what can i do in this mod
what is a town in this mod
entries.answer: Towns of folk that run themselves: they farm, build, trade, marry and vote without you. Found a town of your own or walk into one, and live there as you like.
more: Folk pick trades the town is short of, farm, mine, build, trade, run businesses, marry, raise children, elect leaders and even go to war, all without you.
steps: Found a town with your Founding Kit, or find one by exploring.
Walk in and talk to the folk (right-click one).
Press U for your life in town: work, a shop, a home, citizenship.
Ask this Guide anything along the way.
tips: Nothing needs a command: everything is done with clicks, keys and the folk's own talk options.
Everything is obtainable in survival, and every recipe is in your recipe book from the start.

entries.title: Your first steps
q: im new what do i do
just joined what do i do
what am i meant to do
entries.answer: Right-click your Founding Kit to start a town, or walk into one nearby. Then talk to the folk daily and press U to see what you can do there.
entries.notown: You haven't got a town of your own yet: right-click your Founding Kit (or press U and choose Start a village) and the founding screen opens.
steps: Talk to the folk: right-click one. A word a day makes each one like you a little more.
Press U: your standing, work, a shop, businesses, a home and what to do next, each a button.
Earn your first coin: take a shift from the jobs board, sell goods at a counter, or do a quest.
Become a citizen once the town counts you a friend: a vote, a house, a discount.
tips: The U page's 'What you could do next' always names the next good thing to do.
Lost? Ask this Guide in your own words, e.g. 'how do I earn coins'.

entries.title: Your life in town (the U page)
q: how do i open my life in town
what is your life in town
how do i see my standing
where do i see my job and shop
entries.answer: Press U: your page in the town you stand in, with your standing, money, job, shop, home and what to do next, each a button.
more: Press U for your page in the town you're standing in: who you are to {town} (standing, citizenship, best friend), your purse and earnings, your job, your shop, your businesses, homes, what's going up for you, and 'What you could do next', each with a button to where it's done.
steps: Press U (or click 'You' on the village board, or ask any folk 'Show me my life in town').
Read the top: your standing bar and whether you're a citizen.
Use the buttons: The jobs board, Open a shop, Start a business, Buy the one I'm in, Finances.
Tabs and pages come back up to date after every click; nothing is a command.
controls: [Right-click] a folk → Ask → Favours → My life in town
tips: Out in the wild, the U page offers to start a village of your own instead.
The Camera and Guide buttons sit at the top of the page.

entries.title: Everything you can do (no commands)
q: list of everything i can do
how do i do things without commands
where do i find all the options
entries.answer: A list of every action in the mod and where it's done in the world, each with a button that takes you there. Press U, then 'Everything you can do'.
more: Its tabs: Work, Money, Capital, Shops, Civic, Home and Books.
steps: Press U.
Scroll to the bottom and click 'Everything you can do (no commands)'.
Pick a tab and press the button beside what you want: Open the page, Open, Ask the nearest folk, or Do it.
controls: Tabs: Work · Money · Capital · Shops · Civic · Home · Books
tips: The Money tab gives coin to the treasury; the Capital tab buys land titles and shares.
A few things with no screen of their own (a theatre ticket, entering the fair, busking, the morning news) are done straight from this page.

entries.title: Do I need commands?
q: commands are disabled what do i do
how do i do this without slash commands
is there a command for this
entries.answer: No. Everything is done with clicks, keys and the folk's own talk options, so it works on servers that ban commands.
more: Every player action has its way in the world: a block to right-click, a screen button, a folk's talk option or a key.
Screens that run town actions do it on the server for you, so a server that bans commands doesn't stop them.
steps: Use U for your life in town and 'Everything you can do'.
Right-click folk, counters, boards and stalls.
Use the keys (K camera, J journal, V emotes) and this Guide.
tips: Typing in a folk's talk box isn't a command: it's talking, and works everywhere.

entries.title: Using this Guide
q: how do i use the guide
how do i open the guide
can i ask the guide questions
entries.answer: Press E and click the book with the question mark, or press H. Type a question in your own words and press Enter.
more: Open the inventory (E) and click the book button beside the crafting area, press the Guide key (H by default), or press Guide on the U page or the welcome card.
steps: Open the Guide from the inventory's book button, the Guide key, or the U page.
Use the up and down arrows for questions you asked before.
Click a Related chip to read the next article; Esc goes back.
tips: It all runs on your own computer, offline: no chat, no network.
Click anywhere or press a key to show a reply at once.

entries.title: The town's books (the village board)
q: how do i see town stats
how do i open the city books
how do i check my town's stats
see how my town is doing
entries.answer: The town's books are a dashboard of everything about the town. Right-click the village board on the square to open them.
more: Sections down the left (Overview, People, Economy, Town, Civic, Culture, Records), each with its pages as tabs across the top.
steps: Start on the Overview: food, homes, jobs, coin a day, safety and looks, with what needs attention now.
Pick a section on the left, then a page tab; keys 1-7 jump to a section, left and right change page.
Click a folk's name anywhere to open its profile.
tips: Most pages are written each morning, so a brand-new town's books fill in from its first day on.
The header's star opens your favourites; the New village button founds another town.

The header's buttons: You (your life in town), Start a business and New village; in a narrow window or at a big GUI scale they read You, Business and Found, and one button steps through the charts' ranges (7d, 30d, 100d, All).

entries.title: The village journal (J)
q: how do i see the town status
how do i check what my town is short of
entries.answer: The village journal is the town's status on one page. Press J in a town.
more: Press J in a town for the village journal: the town's status on one page (trades, stores, beds, the watch, the elder's orders, what it's short of), plus Wages and Economy tabs and a Books › tab that opens the town's books.
steps: Stand in or near a town and press J.
Switch tabs: Village, Wages, Economy, Books ›.
The foot shows the pace of time (the same as the [ ] \ keys).

entries.title: Living in somebody else's town
q: how do i join an existing village
how do i move into a town
can i live in a town i didnt found
how do i join someone elses town
how to settle in a village
can i live with the folk
how do i become part of a town
entries.answer: Just walk in: any town takes you as a visitor. Make friends and it will make you a citizen.
more: You can work, trade, open a shop, buy a house and stand for leader in any town, founded by you or not.
steps: Walk into the town: you're told its name and what you are to it.
Talk to folk daily, give presents and help out until you're a Friend of the village.
Ask any folk 'May I live here?' to become a citizen (20 coins, or free if it already built you a house).
Press U to find work, a shop or a home there.
controls: [Right-click] a folk → Town → Council → Live here?

entries.title: Walking into a town
q: how do i know which town im in
message when i enter a village
how do i find the nearest town
entries.answer: Walk in and you're told the town's name, age, size and what you are to it. Ask a folk 'Neighbours' to hear of towns round about.
more: Walking into a town you're told its name, age, how many live there and what you are to it.
Come back after a day away and the nearest folk who knows you catches you up on the news.
Out in the wild with no town of your own, you're reminded now and then that you can found one.
steps: To find towns, explore: towns appear in groups as you go (if the server allows natural villages).
Ask a folk 'Neighbours' (World tab) about the towns round about, or open the war room's map table for a map of the region.

entries.title: Survival, creative and the recipe book
q: where are the mod items in creative
how do i find the recipes
can i get everything without creative
entries.answer: Everything is obtainable in survival, and every recipe is in your recipe book from the start. In creative, it's all in the Village Folk tab.
tips: Three recipes are taught by masters (the reinforced pickaxe, brewer's stout and farmhouse pie): learn them as an apprentice.
The village coin has no recipe: it's struck at a town's mint, or traded for gold at a stall's counter.
